title: Sauerbraten German Herb Pilaf
description: A classic German recipe with a twist, featuring marinated beef and herb pilaf.

ingredients.name: herb pilaf
ingredients.notes: made with herbs like thyme and parsley

instructions: 1. Marinate the beef in a mixture of red wine vinegar, mustard, salt, pepper, and allspice for at least 2 days.
3. In a large Dutch oven, heat a couple of tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Sear the beef until browned on all sides.
4. Add the sauerkraut, sautéed onions, and marinating liquid to the pot. Cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
5. Cook the beef for 3-4 hours or until tender.
6. While the beef is cooking, prepare the herb pilaf according to package instructions.
7. Once the beef is done, remove it from the pot and let it rest for 10 minutes.
8. Slice the beef against the grain and serve with the pilaf and sauerkraut mixture.
10. Discard any remaining marinating liquid and pot residue.
